items.title: Jacobian = Albanese (top goal)
items.summary:
**North star.** For a smooth proper geometrically-irreducible curve $C/k$, the Jacobian is an abelian variety representing the degree-$0$ relative Picard functor and realizing the Albanese property:
$$\mathrm{Pic}^{0}_{C/k}(T)\;=\;\ker\!\big(\mathrm{Pic}(C\times_{k}T)\to\mathrm{Pic}(C)\big),\qquad \dim_{k}\mathrm{Pic}^{0}_{C/k}=g.$$
Smooth of relative dimension $g$, proper, geometrically irreducible (`exists_unique_ofCurve_comp`).

items.title: Pic^0 is an abelian variety (A.3)
items.summary:
**$\mathrm{Pic}^{0}$ is an abelian variety (A.3).** Kleiman §5 tangent-space identification, then structure:
$$T_{e}\,\mathrm{Pic}^{0}_{C/k}\;\cong\;H^{1}(C,\mathcal{O}_{C}),\qquad \dim=g.$$
Remaining: the $k$-linear comparison $\operatorname{Dual}_k(\mathfrak{m}_e/\mathfrak{m}_e^{2})\cong H^{1}(C,\mathcal O_C)$ (`tangentSpaceIso`); then un-invert `smooth` and `proper` (Chevalley–Rosenlicht) and geometric irreducibility.

$$\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)\;\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\;\Gamma(C\times_k T,\ \mathcal O_{C\times_k T}),\qquad \pi=\operatorname{pr}_T,$$
is an isomorphism (`isIso_snd_appTop`: degree-0 cohomology-and-base-change, the per-affine-open $H^0$ base change assembled over the affine-opens basis).

items.title: Codim-one & Thm 3.2 rational-map extension
items.summary:
**Codim-one & Thm 3.2 rational-map extension.** A rational map from a smooth variety to an abelian variety extends off a locus of codimension $\ge 2$:
$$X\dashrightarrow A\ \Longrightarrow\ X\setminus Z\to A,\ \operatorname{codim}Z\ge 2.$$
Milne 3.1 (codim-$\ge2$ indeterminacy, valuative) and the empty-locus extension theorem are proved; `Thm32RationalMapExtension` is sorry-free. The chain is now gated on the single remaining leaf **Milne 3.3** (`indeterminacy_pure_codim_one_into_grpScheme`): a pure-codim-$1$ indeterminacy point of a map into a group scheme forces the difference-map contradiction.

comments.body: The Quot functor and the relative Grassmannian functor are now **real definitions** (run 0010, session 0084): $\mathrm{Quot}^{\Phi,L}_{E/X/S}(T)$ is the set of equivalence classes of families $(\mathcal F, q\colon E_T \twoheadrightarrow \mathcal F)$ on $X\times_S T$ — finitely presented, flat over $T$, with proper schematic support and fibrewise Hilbert polynomial $\Phi$ — modulo $\ker q = \ker q^{\prime}$, functorial by base change; $\mathrm{Grass}(V,d)(T)$ is the set of rank-$d$ locally free quotients of $V_T$. Functoriality is derived from the pseudofunctor coherence laws of the module pullback (unitality and associativity, conjugated by transport along the base-change triangles). The four base-change facts behind well-definedness (finite presentation, flatness, proper support, invariance of the fibrewise Hilbert function) are factored as named lemmas — finite presentation proved up to an index-bookkeeping leaf, the other three pinned as true typed sorries with blueprint nodes (`sec:quot_base_change`). Representability of both functors is now stated against the real functors in `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/QuotFunctorDef.lean`.

v4.31.0 migration fix patterns (Cech + GR push-pull/pullback proofs)

Effective repairs for the **v4.31.0 defeq-transparency-wall** breaks in these projects:

- **Port from the AJC copy first.** `MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge/.../<same file>` is often already sorry-free (e.g. `PresheafCech.lean`, `CechSectionIdentificationBase.lean`). `diff` the subproject vs AJC; if they differ only in the sorry regions, copy the AJC file wholesale.
- **`set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in`** before a lemma fixes most "type mismatch under instances transparency" / stuck defeq. **Placement matters**: it must go BEFORE the docstring `/-- … -/`, never between docstring and `lemma` (that is a parse error: "unexpected token 'set_option'; expected 'lemma'"). Stacks with `set_option maxHeartbeats N in`.
- **`erw [Category.comp_id]` / `erw [Category.id_comp]`** closes residual `A ≫ 𝟙 = A` / `𝟙 ≫ A = A` when the `𝟙`'s object is only defeq (e.g. `(𝟭).obj M` vs `M`, or a `⋙`-form) so `simp`/`exact Category.comp_id _` fail. `erw` matches through the wall then auto-`rfl`.
- **`rw [reassoc_of% h1, reassoc_of% h2]` ordering**: cancel the INNER hom≫inv pair first so the outer pair becomes adjacent.
- **`subst h; simp <;> rfl`** for eqToHom-transport lemmas whose two sides reduce to defeq-but-not-syntactic `map = map`.
- **LSP is dead** on these full-`import Mathlib` files (server crashes / broken pipe). Iterate with `lake build <module>` and read the printed unsolved-goal state from the error output. `GlueDescent` ≈ 2.6 min/build; `CechHigherDirectImage` ≈ 8.5 min/build.

**T8 session: root cause sharpened, 1 of 9 errors fixed, repair recipe validated.**

Fresh 61s build of GR `SectionGradedRing.lean` shows **9 errors (I-0006 line list is stale)**: `1666` rfl, `1707` congr-fallout, `1892`/`1940`/`2646` rw-pattern-not-found, `3147`/`3179` no-goals, `3180`/`3833` whnf timeouts. The `LocalizedMonoidal` synth failure is GONE.

Per chart: `Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc` + `← Spec.map_comp` + `change` collapses `awayι ≫ hom` to `Spec.map (algebraMap k̄ (Away 𝒜 (X i)))`, then the affine recipe. Intersection: any preimage of the generic point `⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot, …⟩` under `pullback.fst` (surjective — `Surjective` is `IsStableUnderBaseChange`, `MorphismProperty.pullback_fst`). **Recipe: ValuativeCommSq for rational-map extension (Milne 3.1 codim-≥2 CLOSED); over-k̄ hypothesis is required.**

`indeterminacy_codimGe2_of_smooth_of_complete` (Albanese `CodimOneExtension.lean`) is proved axiom-clean — Mathlib v4.31 has ALL the plumbing; do not hand-roll rational-map/valuative machinery. Reusable recipe:

- **Pipeline**: `f.fromFunctionField : Spec K(X) ⟶ Y` + Mathlib `IsFractionRing (stalk z) K(X)` (integral schemes) + DVR stalk ⇒ `ValuativeCommSq Y.hom`; extract the lift from `IsProper.eq_valuativeCriterion` (`rw at hP; exact hP.1.1.1`); spread out with `PartialMap.ofFromSpecStalk X.hom Y.hom L hfacr` (`[X.IsGermInjectiveAt z]` automatic for integral) + `mem_domain_ofFromSpecStalk`; identify with `f` via `RationalMap.eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq` + a small glue lemma `fromFunctionField = Spec.map (stalkSpecializes gen⤳z) ≫ fromSpecStalkOfMem` (prove by `cancel_mono g.domain.ι` + `Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι` + `SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk`).
- `CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (stalk z) functionField) = stalkSpecializes ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)` is **rfl** (`stalkFunctionFieldAlgebra` def) — exploit by defeq (`exact`), do NOT `rw` (higher-order pattern fails).
- **Structure-literal trap**: inside a `ValuativeCommSq { ... }` literal the stalk term gets unfolded past `Scheme.presheaf`, so keyed instances (`IsDomain (stalk z)`, `Field functionField`, `IsFractionRing`, `stalkFunctionFieldAlgebra`) STOP firing. Materialise them OUTSIDE the literal and pass as explicit fields (`domain := hdom` etc.).
- **Field-poisoning trap**: bind those facts with plain `have`/`let`, NEVER `haveI/letI` — an opaque local `Field functionField` fvar shadows the CommRing path and makes `Algebra (stalk z) K(X)` unsynthesizable. Also needs `set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in` BEFORE the docstring (IsField.toField / CommRingCat.of-eta walls).
- **Over-k̄ is mathematically necessary**: the valuative square's base compatibility needs `hf : f.compHom Y.hom = X.hom.toRationalMap` (Milne's maps are k̄-maps). The whole Thm-3.2 chain now threads this hypothesis; future consumers must supply it (for maps built from k̄-morphisms it follows via `Hom.toRationalMap`/`compHom_toRationalMap`). Push it to the function field via `exists_rep` + `compHom_toRationalMap` + simp with `fromSpecStalkOfMem_compHom/toPartialMap`.
- Coheight conventions: scheme points carry `specializationPreorder` (Mathlib instance, `x ≤ y ↔ y ⤳ x`); coheight 0 ⇔ `IsMax` (`Order.coheight_eq_zero`) ⇒ generic point via `Specializes.antisymm ...|>.eq`; `ENat.lt_two_iff` for the ≤1 split.

local_inbox.body:
Recipe: building ModuleCat-R morphisms into sheaf-of-modules section objects (v4.31) — the ConcreteCategory.ofHom + presheaf-obj pattern, and the let-fvar IsIso gotcha

Landed in `tildeIso_of_isQuasicoherent_isAffineOpen` (`QuotScheme.lean`, T12 run 0010). When you need `f : ModuleCat.of R M ⟶ <sections object>` (e.g. to feed `tilde.map`):

- **Target the honest `ModuleCat R` object** `(modulesSpecToSheaf.obj G).presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)` — this is literally the domain module of Mathlib's `fromTildeΓ`/`toOpen`. Do NOT target `moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj G` via `ModuleCat.ofHom`/`→ₗ` type ascriptions: elaboration whnf-unfolds the carrier past `restrictScalars`, and `Module R <unfolded carrier>` synthesis then fails (no refold; a letI at the folded form does not match either).
- **Construct via `ConcreteCategory.ofHom { toFun := ..., map_add' := ..., map_smul' := ... }`** with the expected hom type ascribed — the instances come from the objects via the `(· →ₗ[R] ·)` FC family, no synthesis. A bare `let blin : M →ₗ[R] <object> := ...` fails; skipping the standalone LinearMap and going straight to the categorical hom works.
- **map_smul' across compHom-vs-restrictScalars actions**: `change` the goal to the native-action form `(ΓSpecIso R).inv.hom r • f x`, then `rw [← hact]; exact h1` where `hact : appLE V ⊤ e = (ΓSpecIso R).inv` (proved by `rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, fromSpec_app_self, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, Subsingleton.elim _ (𝟙 ⊤), op_id, map_id, comp_id]`).
- **IsIso of `tilde.map b'` for a `let`-bound b'**: `haveI : IsIso (tilde.map b') := by rw [show tilde.map b' = (tilde.functor _).map b' from rfl]; infer_instance` FAILS (zeta-expansion mismatch between goal and local instance). Use `inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((tilde.functor _).map b'))` — works even without `clear_value`.
- **Unit-component bijectivity at open immersions**: `Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app (restrictAdjunction j) (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j) N` + `restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app` (plain presheaf restriction along `j''ᵁj⁻¹ᵁV = V`) + component of `restrictFunctorIsoPullback`. When `rw [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply]` fails with "target not type-correct under instances transparency" (`Γ((𝟭 X.Modules).obj N, V)` forms), do `change`-restatement at the type-correct form, then close with `exact congrArg (fun φ => (AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom φ) y) hcomp` where `hcomp : f ≫ g = 𝟙 _` — both sides defeq, no rewriting in the wall.
- **Σ-pair trace**: `tilde.toOpen_map_app` (naturality) + `toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app` at `⊤` (+ `homOfLE le_top = 𝟙 ⊤` by `Subsingleton.elim`) give `(tilde.map b' ≫ fromTildeΓ).app ⊤ ∘ toOpen = b'` elementwise, via `congrArg`-chains only.

local_inbox.body:
**Recipes: module-level dévissage in Lean v4.31 (landed in FlatteningStratification GenericFreeness, run 0010 T12 r2) — reuse for any prime-filtration/SES argument.**

- **ModuleCat SES arguments need ONE universe**: `ModuleCat.ofHom {X Y : Type v}` forces all modules of a `ShortComplex (ModuleCat R)` into the same universe. Binders `{M₁ M₂ M₃ : Type*}` give distinct universes and produce baffling failures — instance goals displayed as raw `Quot ⇑(OreLocalization.oreEqv ...)` (LocalizedModule unfolded past its instance heads) plus universe-mismatched `Eq.{max u_1 u_4}` vs `Eq.{max u_1 u_2}`. Pin `Type v`. The dévissage eliminator is single-universe anyway.
- **`set S := Submonoid.powers (f*g)` breaks instance unification** in localized-module types (same family as the known let-fvar IsIso gotcha): instance search will not zeta-unfold the set-fvar when unifying `Localization S'` heads. Write the submonoid term explicitly everywhere; `let`-bound MAPS (data) are fine — only types/instances mind.
- **Quantified-instance motive** for `IsNoetherianRing.induction_on_isQuotientEquivQuotientPrime` when the property lives over a DIFFERENT ring A than the induction ring B: `motive N _ iMB _ := ∀ (iA : Module A N), @IsScalarTower A B N Algebra.toSMul iMB.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSMul iA.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSMul → @P A N _ _ iA`. Cases: subsingleton via @-application; quotient case transports along `(e.restrictScalars A).symm` (canonical tower on B⧸p is instance-found); exact case builds `letI iA₁ := Module.compHom N₁ (algebraMap A B)` + tower `⟨fun a b n => by change (a • b) • n = algebraMap A B a • b • n; rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_smul]⟩`; B-linear maps restrict via `LinearMap.restrictScalars A` and inj/surj/Exact transfer definitionally. Final application `... ‹Module A M› ‹IsScalarTower A B M›` unifies. Compiled essentially first-try.
- **Two-localization freeness transport** (`M_f` free ⟹ `M_{fg}` free) WITHOUT IsLocalizedModule-composition: `(IsLocalization.Away.awayToAwayRight f g).toAlgebra` + `IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (awayToAwayRight_eq ..).symm`, then equiv-chain `congr(refl, isBaseChange f) .symm ≪≫ cancelBaseChange ≪≫ isBaseChange (f*g)` and `Module.Free.tensor` + `Module.Free.of_equiv'`. Give every LinearEquiv a fully-typed `have` — `refine LinearEquiv.trans ?_ e` with open source type sticks on RingHomCompTriple metavariables.
- **Localized SES**: `IsLocalizedModule.map/map_injective/map_surjective/map_exact` at `mkLinearMap`s, upgrade R-linear→Loc-linear with `LinearMap.extendScalarsOfIsLocalization` (coe unchanged, so Function.Exact/Injective/Surjective transfer by defeq); `ShortComplex.mk (ofHom u') (ofHom v') (ModuleCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => hexact.apply_apply_eq_zero x))`; ShortExact via `moduleCat_exact_iff` + `mono_iff_injective` + `epi_iff_surjective`; finish `ModuleCat.free_shortExact`.
- **refine-under-binder**: `refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_` fails (?_ under lambda); use `apply` + `intro` + `induction x using LocalizedModule.induction_on with | _ m s => ...`. `Submonoid.mk_smul` bridges `(⟨c,hc⟩ : ↥S) • m` to `c • m`.
